# Camera-diverse metadata corpus

These files are compact format test vectors from the independently maintained
[ExifTool test suite](https://github.com/exiftool/exiftool/tree/master/t/images),
retrieved on 2026-09-06. They are test fixtures only and are not copied into
the PWA build.

The source repository distributes ExifTool under the same terms as Perl (GPL
or Artistic License). The expected capture times below are ExifTool’s labels,
not values generated by Photo Stack Proof.

| Fixture | Source format and labelled evidence | Expected product result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sf-photo-stack-proof-iphone7.jpg` | Apple iPhone 7 JPEG; DateTimeOriginal `2016-09-28T18:18:05Z` | capture time read |
| `sf-photo-stack-proof-canon.cr2` | Canon EOS 350D CR2; DateTimeOriginal `2005-08-03T18:59:18Z` | capture time read |
| `sf-photo-stack-proof-canon.dng` | Canon EOS 350D DNG; DateTimeOriginal `2005-08-03T18:59:18Z` | capture time read |
| `sf-photo-stack-proof-panasonic.rw2` | Panasonic DMC-LX3 RW2; DateTimeOriginal `2008-08-06T15:21:56Z` | capture time read |
| `sf-photo-stack-proof-quicktime.mov` | QuickTime MOV test vector; no supported identifier/time label | ambiguous unless sidecars provide proof |

The unit corpus repeats these independently labelled camera files across 100
same-basename candidate groups. Ninety groups have deliberately different
sidecar identifiers and must be conflicts. Ten share an identifier and may be
verified. The QuickTime vector’s missing compatible evidence is explicitly
checked as missing, never treated as safe.
